causalInference.statement: The frozen JSON null replacement is not preserved as a null object by the active Unity JsonUtility schedule deserialization path. The resulting non-null replacement DTO has no valid superblockId, so RunnerV2 enters the replacement branch and fails before the instrument self-test can execute.
basis: The authoritative schedule row 0 contains the replacement member with JSON null.
The frozen RunnerV2 can emit the observed message only after row.replacement != null evaluates true.
The first replacement guard then rejects an empty or whitespace superblockId.
Unity emitted that exact guard message before any process ledger or instrument receipt was produced.

nextRequiredAction: A separately authorized schedule-null/RunnerV2 deserialization compatibility corrigendum is required.
